Decision boundary

V4 uses UK titanium import history, Bank of England FX, ERUC/PPI, supplier structure, seasonality and data-quality features. Cross-metal World Bank proxies and stale USGS inputs are excluded. Production approval still requires every required acceptance test and a genuinely prospective holdout.
